identityStatus: Node 1237643705 carries exact Q498583. National tourism position is approximately 3.5 m north of this mapped tower base; society longitude is over 1 km west and is rejected.
axis: +Y up; +Z faces the reconstructed northwest entry/viewpoint direction. Baked representative -2-degree local X lean therefore points northeast; this is not a measured present tilt.
geometryLabel: Credited 2023 camera-to-tower sightline; reconstructed doorway quadrant, not a footprint

cameraControl.basis: Own-work photo shows the entrance approximately facing the shoreline camera. The reported camera location is northwest of the tower despite East in the filename. Use the actual credited coordinate, with a broad angular allowance; no compass survey is asserted.

waterControl.basis: National tourism and inspected photographs show the visible base in the sea. Source Y=0 represents the model waterline placed at the host sea-level plane. It is a visual datum convention, not a measured tide or submerged footing height.

limits: Photographer GPS and a front-facing door give a reconstructed northwest quadrant only, +/-20 degrees; the exact entrance bearing is not surveyed. The tower lean changes, and -2 degrees is a static representative pose. No tower footprint, submerged footing, bathymetry, current tide or accurate shore outline is claimed. Society 21.8213066 longitude contradicts the national tourism and exact-QID positions and is excluded.
